interface.longDescription: A symbolic interpretation copilot for astrologers using Astroanamnesis, the method developed by Eliseo Gallardo. Connect your Astroanamnesis account; the server checks its access permissions on protected operations. Explore only the chart view and context you expressly share from Maps through a private, revocable reference that expires after seven days. Resume one expressly shared notebook entry with its follow-ups; its previous response is included only if you select it. Request direct stations or the next exact Tropical natal transit from a shared chart with calculation access. Results come from the platform calculation engines and include their time context and a private result link. When you ask to keep a summary or a linked revision, the plugin prepares a draft for you to review, edit and confirm on the website; it does not automatically save or overwrite notebook entries. Choose Help me understand, Go deeper or Prepare a consultation, with response length and language preferences. The plugin cannot list all your people or notebook entries, recover other chats, calculate complete charts from new birth data in chat, process payments or change your account. It does not diagnose conditions, provide medical advice or replace professional judgement.
